messages:
Meera Shah: Quick heads-up — launching a small org change and hiring pool today: we are creating an "Embedded Customer Success Engineering" (Embedded CSE) stream to focus on deeply embedding Redwood into top-tier customers (private deployments, dedicated/high-throughput). Anya Patel is joining as Director, Embedded CSE and will start Mon Apr 28. :tada:

Meera Shah: High-level: Embedded CSE will split out from the existing CS-Platform org. Embedded roles (customer-facing integration + on-call for private deployments) will report to Anya. Platform-facing folks (core cs infra, observability integrations) remain with Lizzy. No net headcount increase this quarter — we’re reallocating two open CS Ops ICs + one Platform contractor slot into this stream.

Meera Shah: Hiring priorities (Q2):
- 2x Senior Embedded CSE (customer integrations, GPU/infra experience)
- 1x Staff SWE (integration + automation)
- 1x TPM (embedded rollouts)

Meera Shah: Recruiting will create reqs today. Requesting each hiring manager to nominate interviewers + a tech lead for loop by EOD Thu. Link with details: <https://intranet.redwood/example-embedded-cse-hiring> (doc with scoring rubric + sample loop).

Recruiting Bot: New requisitions created: REQ-4782 (Senior Embedded CSE), REQ-4783 (Senior Embedded CSE), REQ-4784 (Staff SWE), REQ-4785 (TPM). Hiring owners assigned: Anya Patel (REQ-4782/3/5), Lizzy Mendoza (REQ-4784). Panel owner: Evan Carter.

Lizzy Mendoza: Congrats Anya! Quick Q on escalation: if an Embedded CSE needs platform changes, the escalation path should be to me (platform lead) and cc Anya — is that OK? Also propose a weekly sync between Anya/Lizzy/Platform-eng to triage cross-customer work.

Anya Patel: Thanks all — super excited to join. Yes @Lizzy that escalation path sounds right. I’ll set up the weekly sync and book recurring 30m. I’ll also post a short onboarding doc tomorrow with priorities for the first 60/90 days.

Evan Carter: Congrats Anya! For the loops, we should include one model-infra question + a short architecture take-home scenario. We can repurpose two questions from the runtime interview pack. @Recruiting Bot can you attach the runtime pack to the loop?

Recruiting Bot: Attached: runtime-interview-pack.pdf and sample-infra-scenario.md to all REQs.

Ash Sinha: Heads-up from a capacity/budget side — people-ops will fast-track approvals for these reqs given they’re re-allocations, but we need hiring manager scorecards ready before interviews. Also flagging compensation for embedded senior roles may need an uplift (~7%) due to customer travel/on-call.

Meera Shah: Action items:
1) Recruiting: finalize job descriptions and post by EOD today (assigned).
2) Anya/Lizzy: weekly sync invite + onboarding doc (Anya)
3) Hiring managers (Anya/Lizzy/Evan): nominate interviewers & agree on loop by Thu EOD
4) People-ops (Ash): run budget approval and compensation guidance this week
5) All: please add any candidate source suggestions in the doc (referrals, partner channels).

Anya Patel: Will do — thanks everyone. Ping me for 1:1 intros.

Lizzy Mendoza: Welcome again, Anya :wave: Looking forward to pairing on the first two candidates.

Evan Carter: I'll draft the loop and share with Anya/Lizzy tomorrow morning.

Recruiting Bot: Notification: candidate referral form updated at <https://intranet.redwood/referrals>.

Meera Shah: Thanks team — keeping this thread for updates. Expect a short announcement to customers/solutions as we onboard the first hires. :sparkles:
